title: 5x5 pillar grid
prompt: Build a 5x5 grid of pillars from the engine mesh /Engine/BasicShapes/Cylinder, each scaled (1, 1, 4), 400 units apart in X and Y with the first pillar at the world origin. Label them Pillar_<n> and put them in the World Outliner folder 'Pillars'.

scene.expr: len([a for a in actors if a.get_actor_label().startswith('Pillar')]) == 25
scene.name: 25 pillars

scene.expr: all(str(a.get_folder_path()) == 'Pillars' for a in [a for a in actors if a.get_actor_label().startswith('Pillar')])
scene.name: in folder

scene.expr: sorted({round(a.get_actor_location().x) for a in [a for a in actors if a.get_actor_label().startswith('Pillar')]}) == [0, 400, 800, 1200, 1600]
scene.name: x spacing

scene.expr: sorted({round(a.get_actor_location().y) for a in [a for a in actors if a.get_actor_label().startswith('Pillar')]}) == [0, 400, 800, 1200, 1600]
scene.name: y spacing

scene.expr: all(abs(a.get_actor_scale3d().z - 4) < 0.01 for a in [a for a in actors if a.get_actor_label().startswith('Pillar')])
scene.name: scaled
